## Summary

Describe the user-visible behavior and why it belongs in Codex Trajectory.

## Privacy impact

State whether the change affects session discovery, returned task content, redaction, or full-detail consent.

## Validation

- [ ] `uv run ruff format --check .`
- [ ] `uv run ruff check .`
- [ ] `uv run mypy`
- [ ] `uv run pytest --cov --cov-report=term-missing`
- [ ] English and Chinese documentation are synchronized when behavior changed.
- [ ] No real logs, credentials, base instructions, encrypted reasoning, or unredacted screenshots are included.
